note: Triennial election of the rural district council, 1933: nominations received by W. Calvert, clerk, 25 April 1933. The Armagh Guardian list has no entry for Richhill and includes a "Keady—Thomas Mallon, J.P. (N.)" line that appears to belong to the county council list, so neither is filed here. Polled 25 May 1933 ("an 85 per cent. poll", Armagh Guardian, 2 June 1933, p. 4). Downard was the retiring member; Troughton stood for the Farmers' Defence Association.
